app.title: QualityBound
gui.tooltip.min_vmaf: Minimum SMART quality score. Recommended: 90. It combines each sample's mean VMAF with its worst one-second period; higher values usually increase file size.
gui.label.size_blocked_policy: If Smart analysis predicts VMAF needs a larger file
gui.tooltip.size_blocked_policy: Applies to candidate selection before the full encode. If the chosen policy cannot resolve a conflict and the required output is larger than the source, Smart skips the file. Actual full-encode size misses are preserved for a separate decision.
gui.label.quality_unreachable_policy: If tested candidates miss the VMAF target
gui.value.size_blocked_relax_size: Allow a larger file, up to source size
gui.label.skipped_output_policy: When Smart analysis skips a file
gui.tooltip.skipped_output_policy: Applies to Smart-analysis skips, including predicted oversize and manual Skip choices. Runs after executable files finish even when other items still need a decision. planning skips and discarded actual-size misses are excluded.
gui.value.skipped_output_copy: Copy the source to the planned output path
gui.group.smart_policies: When Smart analysis cannot meet both targets
gui.tooltip.analysis_profile: Controls Smart analysis confidence through timeline scouting, difficult-content coverage, and independent verification.
gui.tooltip.viewing_context: The default uses the stricter high-fidelity quality assumption, including demanding large-display viewing for 4K sources. Choose Standard display only when that viewing condition matches your intended use.
gui.dialog.copy_skipped_title: Copy files skipped by Smart analysis?
gui.dialog.copy_skipped_text:

gui.tooltip.encode_workers: Maximum full-file encodes running at once (1-8). Smart analysis still finishes before full encoding. Higher values may contend for CPU, GPU memory, and hardware encoder sessions.

gui.compare.title: Video comparison
gui.compare.offset_hint: B time = A time + offset. Positive values skip the beginning of B. Frame buttons use actual B frame timestamps.
gui.compare.help: Space: play/pause · Tab: switch A/B in single view · ←/→: seek 5 seconds. Click or drag the timeline to seek both videos. Precise inspection aligns paused frames by timestamp; playback shares one presentation clock. All decoding uses the selected external FFmpeg.
gui.compare.no_overlap: No common playback interval. Adjust the B offset.
gui.compare.error: Comparison failed: {error}. Check the files/tools, or select normal synchronization if only precise inspection failed.
gui.compare.audio_unavailable: Synchronized playback · no audio output device is available.
gui.about.title: About QualityBound
gui.about.text:
QualityBound is a local batch compressor.

It turns an explicit quality and size constraint into one published file whose quality and size were measured on the finished output. All probing, encoding and measurement stay on this machine.
gui.tooltip.ratio: Output size as a fraction of the source. Used only in fixed-bitrate mode.
gui.tooltip.max_output_ratio: Maximum output size as a percentage of the source. Smart mode also uses this as the size ceiling.
gui.tooltip.workdir: Temporary files and logs are written here. Published videos go to the output folder.

gui.empty.body: Drop files or folders here, or add them from the toolbar. Set the quality and size targets, then start the queue.
